WITH RECURSIVE date_range AS ( SELECT DATE(#{from}) AS d UNION ALL SELECT d + INTERVAL 1 DAY FROM date_range WHERE d + INTERVAL 1 DAY <= DATE(#{to}) ) SELECT period, status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM ( SELECT AS period, t.status AS status FROM date_range dr JOIN tasks t ON t.is_deleted = false AND t.task_type != 'WBS_TASK' AND DATE(COALESCE(t.start_date, t.created_at)) <= dr.d AND DATE(COALESCE(t.end_date, t.start_date, t.created_at)) >= dr.d
AND t.creator_id IN ()
AND t.creator_id = #{userId}
UNION ALL
SELECT AS period, t.status AS status FROM date_range dr JOIN tasks t ON t.is_deleted = false AND t.task_type = 'WBS_TASK' AND DATE(COALESCE(t.start_date, t.created_at)) <= dr.d AND DATE(COALESCE(t.end_date, t.start_date, t.created_at)) >= dr.d JOIN task_assignees ta ON ta.task_id = t.id
AND ta.user_id IN ()
AND ta.user_id = #{userId}
) combined GROUP BY period, status
UNION ALL
SELECT AS period, NULL AS status, 0 AS count FROM date_range dr
ORDER BY period, status

SELECT DISTINCT t.* FROM tasks t LEFT JOIN task_assignees ta ON t.id = ta.task_id WHERE t.is_deleted = false AND t.task_type = 'EVENT' AND t.start_date < DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND (t.end_date >= CURDATE() OR (t.end_date IS NULL AND t.start_date >= CURDATE())) AND (t.creator_id = #{userId} OR ta.user_id = #{userId}) ORDER BY t.start_date

SELECT DISTINCT t.* FROM tasks t LEFT JOIN task_assignees ta ON t.id = ta.task_id WHERE t.is_deleted = false AND t.task_type = 'WBS_TASK' AND t.status NOT IN ('DONE', 'CANCELLED') AND t.start_date < DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND (t.end_date >= CURDATE() OR (t.end_date IS NULL AND t.start_date >= CURDATE())) AND (t.creator_id = #{userId} OR ta.user_id = #{userId}) ORDER BY t.end_date IS NULL, t.end_date, t.start_date
